name: mooktakim
description: Hand-authored Claude Code skills by Mooktakim Ahmed, one plugin per skill

plugins.name: rails-context
plugins.description: Per-directory AGENTS.md context files for Rails apps (MVC Context), imported by a one-line CLAUDE.md

plugins.name: rails-design-system
plugins.description: Per-section design-system docs for Rails apps on Tailwind v4: role tokens, component specs, page patterns, drift auditing, edit-time enforcement, and a design-reviewer agent

plugins.name: rails-specialists
plugins.description: A team of eight Rails specialist agents: models, jobs, debugging, review, security, performance, deploy, upgrades

plugins.name: rails-minitest
plugins.description: Minitest for Rails apps: the standard for every kind of test, fixtures, shared helpers, state shortcuts, speed, coverage, and flaky tests, a suite audit, and a minitest-runner agent

plugins.name: rails-view-component
plugins.description: ViewComponent for Rails apps: organising, writing, composing, and testing components, Turbo Streams, frames, broadcasts and morphing, Stimulus beside components, forms with the app's own builder, previews, the v4 upgrade, a library audit, and a component-builder agent

plugins.name: rails-hotwire
plugins.description: Hotwire for Rails apps: Turbo Drive, Frames, Streams, broadcasts, Turbo 8 morphing, and Stimulus - form responses, secure streams, state through morphs, UI patterns, accessibility, testing, upgrades, an app audit, and a hotwire-builder agent

plugins.name: rails-generators
plugins.description: Rails generators and commands instead of hand-written files: migrations, schema.rb, every generator and installer, credentials, gems, and importmap pins, with a guard that refuses hand-written migrations and edits to generated files

plugins.name: capture
plugins.description: Record a rule you state, or a correction you make, into the one checked-in context file where it belongs

plugins.name: toolsmith
plugins.description: Small single-purpose Rust commands that replace shell patterns Claude repeats, found by scanning your Claude Code history, with usage tracking

plugins.name: project-log
plugins.description: An append-only work log in git: one immutable entry file per finished unit of work, committed with the work, with lossless migration from older history logs

plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Long-term project memory in git, on top of the project-log work log: typed notes with citations, a generated index, an inbox, and lessons
